regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow (4/22 eligible, 18% breadth) but very top-heavy leadership: Banks and Innovative Pharma & CXO both score ~0.99 and dominate the rank, while everything else is far behind. The detector's own backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it) and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so this is a focus/liquidity lens, not an alpha source. Track record n=77 with 37.7% directional accuracy reinforces humility.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO can build a durable score gap over Banks and take the leader slot with breadth above ~0.55 for two consecutive weeks — that would confirm a real handoff rather than churn. Retire the watch if the Banks-Pharma margin closes back under 0.005 and stays there for a week.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead the ranks with a high durability bar (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.889), the strongest cohesion of any theme. The trend gate marks it eligible, which is the only leg with any validation, but on this market even that gate did not reduce drawdown historically. I lean overweight as a conditional, not because the rank predicts returns.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z=1.78, crowded=true) and on China A-shares mean-reversion whipsaws trend-following; the gate did not hold here, and banking is a policy-sensitive, heavily state-influenced sector that can reverse on a single directive.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 3% or more over a rolling 10-day window before 20 trading days elapse

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the challenger just 0.01 behind Banks on score, also eligible, with decent durability (0.60) and a crowded posture that signals attention is concentrated here too. The one-narrative structure is false and breadth of rotation is narrow, so this is a two-horse leadership tape rather than a broad risk-on. Lean overweight as a conditional co-leader.
theses.dissent: The rotation margin over Banks is negligible (0.01), crowding is elevated, and a narrow-rotation tape with absorption 0.32 means leadership can churn quickly; no confirmed handoff from Banks has occurred.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ falls below a 20-day moving average while the CSI 300 holds flat or gains, before 20 trading days elapse

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is eligible with a mean-revert hurst tag, which on this market's mean-reverting tape is not a trend signal I trust. Durability is only 0.46 and breadth 0.30 — middling cohesion. Without gate help on this market and with no directional edge in the rank, I prefer to stay away rather than chase a cyclical with weak texture.
theses.dissent: Coal is one of only four eligible themes, and mean-revert in a mean-reverting tape could argue for the opposite interpretation; scarcity of eligible themes may make Coal the least bad cyclical option.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS breaks above its 300-day high and holds for 10 consecutive trading days before the horizon ends

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
